independent_acceptance.performing_role: Primary assistant in the assigned acceptance Chat; independent of original initial-review conversation
independent_acceptance.source_claim_and_location: Proposition2.1.1(1)(a)-(c), printed258/PDF5, permits locally closed G-stable Z in mu(X) and nonempty Z_lambdabar. Its proof, printed259/PDF6, treats a component of the restricted inverse image as a component of the full Borel moment fiber.
independent_acceptance.hypotheses_and_quantifiers: Take complex reductive SL2 on the smooth affine symplectic plane(A2,dx wedge dy), upper-triangular B, trace-pairing moment map mu=1/2[[xy,-x^2],[y^2,-xy]], closed invariant Z={0}, and zero Borel character. The required intersection is nonempty. The action is generically transitive/coisotropic, so the example does not evade a general-orbit premise.
independent_acceptance.decisive_independent_check: For A=[[a,b],[c,-a]], contraction with the action field equals d(axy+b y^2/2-c x^2/2); equivariance follows from mu(v)=-v v^T J/2 and the SL2 symplectic identity. The Hamiltonians xy,y^2/2,-x^2/2 satisfy the three stated Poisson brackets. The zero fiber has ideal(x^2,xy,y^2) and sole reduced component the origin. Condition(c) reads0<=1, while(a) requires dimension1 and fails. This dimension counterexample is unaffected by nilpotent scheme structure or an overall sign convention.
independent_acceptance.counterevidence_and_boundaries: The full reduced Borel zero fiber is y=0, a Lagrangian line. The origin selected by Z is a proper closed subset, not a component of that line, and is not coisotropic. With the ordinary reduced interpretation it is isotropic, so(b) also holds. No assertion that later case-by-case counts or part(2)'s open-Z statement fail follows.
independent_acceptance.severity_result: Major retained: an explicitly quantified equivalence in a central general criterion is false and its proof uses a false component/coisotropy inference. This establishes a core local derivation failure without an allegation of whole-paper failure.
independent_acceptance.repair_check: Taking the open Z=mu(X) minus{0} changes the restricted inverse image to the punctured line and removes this dimension-collapse example. An openness/component hypothesis is a concrete repair direction; the full revised equivalence and all downstream uses are not certified.

checked_claims.check: Zero B-moment level is union of conormal bundles to finite B_M x B_N orbits in Hom(C^N,C^M); each has dimension MN. Partial permutations distinguished by southwest rectangular rank profiles; count sum_r binom(M,r)binom(N,r)r!.
checked_claims.result: Independent geometric reconstruction consistent. Exact finite enumeration M,N1..4 confirms representative rank profiles and counts; not a proof of maze/slice side.
